content.text: {"incident_detected":true,"root_cause_hypothesis":"The €10 bonus materially increases 14-day top-up conversion, but its cost is not recovered in the measured 60-day contribution margin: treatment margin is negative and substantially below control after the bonus.","supporting_metrics":[{"name":"TOPUP10 14-day conversion rate","baseline_value":0.6502,"anomaly_value":0.7019,"unit":"fraction","sql":"calculate_uplift_or_stats: analysis='ab_test_readout', overall"},{"name":"TOPUP10 conversion lift","baseline_value":null,"anomaly_value":5.16,"unit":"pp","sql":"calculate_uplift_or_stats: analysis='ab_test_readout', overall; 95% CI 3.35 to 6.98 pp, p=2.69e-08"},{"name":"TOPUP10 average 60-day margin, net of bonus","baseline_value":0.764,"anomaly_value":-5.978,"unit":"EUR/user","sql":"SELECT variant, AVG(margin_60d_eur) FROM fct_experiment_users WHERE experiment_id = 'topup10_2026q1' GROUP BY variant; corroborated by ab_test_readout"},{"name":"TOPUP10 60-day margin delta, net of bonus","baseline_value":null,"anomaly_value":-6.741,"unit":"EUR/user","sql":"calculate_uplift_or_stats: analysis='ab_test_readout', overall"},{"name":"Bonus cost per incremental conversion","baseline_value":null,"anomaly_value":133.1,"unit":"EUR","sql":"calculate_uplift_or_stats: analysis='ab_test_readout', overall"}],"recommended_action":"DO_NOT_SHIP","reasoning_summary":"Treatment conversion was 0.7019 versus 0.6502 in control, a statistically clear lift of 5.16 pp (95% CI 3.35–6.98 pp). However, net 60-day margin was −5.978 EUR/user in treatment versus 0.764 EUR/user in control, a −6.741 EUR/user delta. The estimated bonus cost was 133.1 EUR per incremental conversion, so do not roll out the bonus despite the conversion lift."}
